name: Whirlwind Weapon

angles.text: As a warrior, you can claim a weapon infused with the tempestuous force of Cyclonian.

faq.answer: A warrior can bind Cyclonian's whirlwind heart into a chosen weapon, joining the elemental's power with the warrior's own strength.
faq.q: What is the Whirlwind Weapon quest?

faq.answer: Cyclonian is an elemental manifestation of wind and storm. Its defeat yields the whirlwind heart, which can bind primal wind energy into a physical weapon.
The whirlwind heart is Cyclonian's core, claimed when the elemental is defeated. It holds the tempest's fury and can be bound into a forged vessel chosen by the warrior.
The warrior chooses a forged weapon and has Cyclonian's whirlwind heart bound into it. The elemental's fury then courses through the steel.
A warrior chooses the weapon that will receive Cyclonian's storm essence.
faq.q: What choices are offered for the weapon?

aliases: why does warrior want whirlwind weapon
faq.answer: Warriors seek Cyclonian's power to command the fury of a living gale through their weapons.
faq.q: Why is Cyclonian's power sought after?

sections.body: After Cyclonian falls and the warrior claims its heart, a craftsperson prepares a weapon to hold the storm's power. The heart is fused into the chosen arm, turning forged metal into a channel for elemental fury.
sections.title: Infusing the Storm

sections.body: Cyclonian's heart holds the violence of howling winds and tempestuous gales. Bound into a forged weapon, it lends the wielder the living might of the storm alongside their own martial skill. Each strike carries the force of the defeated elemental, whose storm now rages in the hands of its vanquisher.
sections.title: The Power of Cyclonian

summary: A warrior's chosen weapon awaits the storm Cyclonian left behind. The whirlwind heart can bind the elemental's fury into a forged vessel.
